atu.help: atu help [subcmd]: Display atu command options

addEntry.help: atu addEntry [options] : Creates the new entry in MAC address table

[options](default value for option item: options for atu entry, format as: -macAddr aabbccddee00 -state 7

dump.help: atu dump <fid> : Find all MAC address in the specified fid and print them out

port.help: port help [subcmd]: Display port command options

setDefVid.help: port setDefVid <port> <vid> : Set the port default vlan id

getPortStatus.help: port getPortStatus <portList> : Get ports link/Speed/Duplex/FlowControl status

paraList.portList: logical port number list, format support as 1,3,6/all/1-9

set_an.help: port set_an an : set ports auto-negotiating 0 or 1

paraList.portList: logical port number list, format support as 1,3,6/all/1-9

get_an.help: port get_an <port> : Get ports auto-negotiating status

paraList.portList: logical port number list, format support as 1,3,6/all/1-9

vlan.help: vlan help [subcmd]: Display vtu command options

dump.help: vlan dump : Find all the vlan entries and print them out

mib.help: mib help [subcmd]: Display mib command options

flush.help: mib flush : Flush All MIBs counters for all ports

flushport.help: mib flushport <port> : Flush All MIBs counters for a given port

getPortAllCounter.help: mib getPortAllCounter <port> : Gets all MIBs counters of the given port

getHistogramMode.help: mib getHistogramMode : Gets the Histogram Counters Mode

setHistogramMode.help: mib setHistogramMode <mode>: Sets the Histogram Counters Mode

dump.help: mib dump <portList>: dump all the mibs information for specified port list

paraList.portList: logical port number list, format support as 1,3,5/all/1-4
